Website information and agreements

This website provides general information about Cyentific’s products, services and technical work. The scope of an engagement, supported integrations, deployment arrangements, pricing and service commitments are set out in the applicable written agreement. Contacting us does not create a purchase obligation.

Architecture diagrams and workflow examples illustrate concepts using fictional infrastructure. They do not disclose customer environments or represent measured customer results.

Project and experience attribution

Public project references identify the actual participants, beneficiaries and authors. References to the experience of individuals do not mean that the website operator was the contracting entity or grant beneficiary for every cited project. The responsible supplier and scope of new work are identified in the applicable agreement.

Intellectual property and external references

Website content and branding are protected by applicable intellectual property law. Third-party names, standards and trademarks belong to their respective owners. Open-source software and specifications are governed by their own licences and terms.

Links to repositories, standards bodies and research projects provide technical context and attribution. They do not imply endorsement or certification. External websites are maintained by their respective operators.

Security reporting

To report a suspected vulnerability affecting this website, email contact@cyentific.eu with the subject “Website security report”. Include the affected URL, a clear description and minimal steps needed to reproduce the issue. Please avoid personal data and sensitive customer information.

Coordinate any testing with us in advance. This reporting channel does not authorise access to systems or data, disruptive testing or testing of third-party services. Please give us a reasonable opportunity to investigate before publishing technical details.

Privacy

Information about personal data is available in our privacy notice.
